args.query: select pg_get_viewdef('api.limit_balance'::regclass); select pg_get_viewdef('api.company'::regclass); select * from api.company;

out:
SELECT r.legal_name AS company,
    r.funding_limit,
    COALESCE(ap.approved, (0)::numeric) AS approved,
    COALESCE(k.contracted, (0)::numeric) AS contracted,
    (r.funding_limit - COALESCE(k.contracted, (0)::numeric)) AS remaining
   FROM ((reg.counterparty r
     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT application.company_inn,
            sum(application.amount) AS approved
           FROM api.application
          WHERE (application.status_id = priv.status_id('Одобрена'::text))
          GROUP BY application.company_inn) ap ON ((ap.company_inn = r.inn)))
     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT a.company_inn,
            sum(k_1.amount) AS contracted
           FROM (api.contract k_1
             JOIN api.application a ON ((a.id = k_1.application_id)))
          GROUP BY a.company_inn) k ON ((k.company_inn = r.inn)));
 SELECT inn,
    legal_name AS name,
    funding_limit
   FROM reg.counterparty;
